name: Omacash
author: Slava Baranskyi
description: Remaining money and credits across OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, and Anthropic in one bar pill and popup.

barWidget.description: Prepaid balances, credits, and ledger-estimated remainders for five AI providers, with severity meters and reset countdowns.

schema.label: Pill mode
schema.description: What the bar pill shows: the USD total across providers, the provider that most needs attention, or one pinned provider. No settings GUI exists in this build; set it with: omarchy bar set io.github.baranskyi.omacash pillMode <value>

schema.label: Pinned provider
schema.description: Provider shown when pillMode is pinned. The mouse wheel on the pill cycles this.

schema.label: Show provider tag
schema.description: Prefix the pinned provider's value with its short tag (for example OR $23.40). The attention mode always shows the tag.
